description: Defines structures and functions for frequency domain resource allocation in 5G NR, including resource block configuration, RIV calculation, and special case handling as per 3GPP TS38.214 specifications.

classes.name: ra_frequency_type1_configuration
classes.description: Configuration parameters for Type1 frequency resource allocation, including BWP size, start VRB, and length.

classes.name: ra_frequency_type1_special_configuration
classes.description: Configuration for special case frequency resource allocation, including initial and active BWP sizes, start VRB, and length.

methods.name: ra_frequency_type1_get_riv
methods.description: Calculates resource indication value (RIV) based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: ra_frequency_type1_from_riv
methods.description: Derives resource block configuration from a given RIV.

methods.name: ra_frequency_type1_special_get_riv
methods.description: Calculates RIV for special case configurations considering initial and active BWP sizes.
